title: add --optional: file a child that never gates its parent's completion
outcome: An agent can file review follow-ups and leads under the item they concern without turning them into completion barriers; add --optional creates a ChildRequirement::Optional child, and show marks optional children
acceptance: engram work add "…" --under REF --optional creates an optional child; done on the parent succeeds with that child open; show lists it with an optional marker; parity covers CLI and MCP

completion.summary: Exposed existing optional-child semantics through CLI and MCP add surfaces; optional children are marked in structured and text show output and remain non-gating for parent completion. Updated repository guidance and added CLI/MCP parity coverage, including rejecting --optional without --under.
